findings.rule: handoff-designer.json A2 AC#1 ('avg rating per driver is included')
findings.title: Driver avgRating is windowed to from/to, AC does not specify a window
findings.detail: ComputeAvgRatingAsync (lines 158-165) averages RatingStars only for Completed orders with CreatedAt in [from,to). The A2 AC says 'avg rating per driver is included' without stating it is range-scoped; a driver's average rating is commonly all-time. This is an interpretation, not a contradiction of the AC — but it is a semantic choice the AC leaves open. Report-consumers expecting an all-time rating would see a range-limited number.
findings.recommendation: Confirm with the designer whether avgRating should be all-time or range-scoped; if all-time, drop the CreatedAt window from ComputeAvgRatingAsync. Non-blocking pending that clarification.

findings.rule: handoff-designer.json A1 AC#1 ('configured in FleetConfiguration (no default, backfills null)')
findings.title: LogoUpdatedAt added to entity only; FleetConfiguration.cs (in files_touched) not modified
findings.detail: A1 files_touched lists Infrastructure/Configurations/FleetConfiguration.cs and the AC says LogoUpdatedAt is 'configured in FleetConfiguration'. The staged diff does not touch FleetConfiguration.cs; LogoUpdatedAt is only declared on Fleet.cs (nullable DateTimeOffset?). EF's nullable convention maps it to a nullable timestamptz with no default and existing rows backfill null — exactly the AC's intent — and the migration (1 nullable ADD COLUMN, no default) confirms it. Functionally equivalent; only the literal 'configure in FleetConfiguration' wording is unmet, and the ReportSchema_FleetLogoUpdatedAt_DefaultsNull test passes.
findings.recommendation: No code change required; the outcome matches the AC. Optionally add an explicit FleetConfiguration line for documentation parity.

findings.title: UploadLogoRequest.cs (in files_touched) not created; endpoint uses EndpointWithoutRequest + Files[0]
findings.detail: A6 files_touched lists UploadLogoRequest.cs, but the endpoint is EndpointWithoutRequest reading Files[0] with size/PNG-magic endpoint guards. The design-reviewer explicitly accepted this (MEDIUM#4: 'endpoint guards are defensible for IFormFile; validation.md exempts non-trivial binding — confirm intended'). Developer confirmed intended. Not a dropped validator.

findings.title: SMS unit cost falls back to 1 CZK when no FleetSettings row
findings.detail: ComputeKpisAsync defaults smsUnitCost to 1 when the FleetSettings row is missing (?? 1). Every provisioned fleet seeds FleetSettings (FleetProvisioning + DevelopmentSeeder), so unreachable in practice.
